title: AFCAT 02/2026 - Apply Online from May 20 for 142 IAF Officer Posts, Graduates Eligible
author: Ash K.
summary: Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026 notification released. 142 Commissioned Officer posts in Flying Branch and Ground Duty. Apply online from May 20 to June 19, 2026 at afcat.cdac.in. Graduates with 60% eligible. Both men and women can apply. Exam in August 2026.
body: The Indian Air Force has released the AFCAT 02/2026 notification for recruitment of Commissioned Officers in Flying Branch and Ground Duty (Technical & Non-Technical). Online applications open tomorrow - May 20, 2026.

DetailInformation
Total Posts142 (tentative)
BranchesFlying + Ground Duty (Tech & Non-Tech)
Apply StartMay 20, 2026 (11:00 AM)
Last DateJune 19, 2026 (11:30 PM)
Eligibility - FlyingGraduation (60%) + 12th with Physics & Maths
Eligibility - GD TechB.E./B.Tech from recognized university
Eligibility - GD Non-TechGraduation in any discipline (60%)
Age - Flying20-24 years (as on Jan 1, 2027)
Age - Ground Duty20-26 years
Commission TypeSSC + Permanent Commission
GenderBoth Men and Women eligible
Exam ModeComputer Based (CBT) - August 2026
SelectionAFCAT CBT → AFSB Interview → Medical
Course StartsJuly 2027

How to apply: Visit afcat.cdac.in → Register with email and mobile → Fill application form → Select branch preference (Flying/GD Tech/GD Non-Tech) → Upload photo and signature → Pay fee → Submit. Keep application printout for AFSB interview.

Selection process: Three stages - (1) AFCAT Computer Based Test covering General Awareness, Verbal Ability, Numerical Ability, Reasoning & Military Aptitude. (2) Air Force Selection Board (AFSB) testing over 5 days including psychological tests, group tasks, and personal interview. (3) Medical examination at Air Force Central Medical Establishment.
Also accepting: NCC Special Entry for Flying Branch (no AFCAT exam needed if you have NCC Air Wing Senior Division C certificate) and GATE Score Entry for Ground Duty Technical branches.
For defence exam preparation, check our NDA exam guide. For age relaxation details, see our age relaxation rules.

faqs.question: When can I apply for AFCAT 02/2026?
faqs.answer: Online applications open on May 20, 2026 at 11:00 AM and close on June 19, 2026 at 11:30 PM. Apply at afcat.cdac.in.

faqs.question: Can women apply for AFCAT 02/2026 Flying Branch?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both men and women can apply for Short Service Commission in Flying Branch and Ground Duty branches.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for AFCAT Flying Branch?
faqs.answer: 20-24 years as on January 1, 2027. For Ground Duty branches, the age limit is 20-26 years.

faqs.question: Is AFCAT exam required for NCC candidates?
faqs.answer: No. Candidates with NCC Air Wing Senior Division C certificate can apply under NCC Special Entry for Flying Branch without appearing for AFCAT exam.

faqs.question: When is the AFCAT 02/2026 exam date?
faqs.answer: The AFCAT CBT exam is expected in August 2026. Exact date will be notified on afcat.cdac.in after application window closes.

callout.heading: Applications Open Tomorrow
callout.content: AFCAT 02/2026 online registration opens May 20 at 11:00 AM. Bookmark afcat.cdac.in and apply early to avoid last-minute server issues. Both permanent and short service commission available for men and women.
